nodes.description: Public pot holding ETH reserved to refund losing players; funded by donations, P3D dividends and per-stage seeding.
Public jackpot balance funded with 5% of P3D dividends; paid out on a 1-in-1000 blockhash roll.
Declared 1% SPASM fee accumulator variable that is never actually updated.
Mapping of pending ETH per masternode address, later spent by Expand/changevanity to buy P3D.
Private mapping of player address to withdrawable earnings/vault balance.
Mapping of stage index to Stage struct storing players, blocknumber and finalization flag.
Mapping of queue position to address waiting for a 0.1 ETH loser refund.
Mapping of finalized stage index to the address chosen as the loser/sacrifice.
Queue cursor of the next refund recipient; incremented after each payout.
Queue cursor of the next free spot where a loser is appended.
Count of stages already finalized; used as index into finalization logic.
Count of created stages; used as the active stage index.
Public mapping of player address to a vanity string set through changevanity.
Fixed 0.185 ETH credited to each surviving player per finalized stage.
Constant public cap of 2 players per stage.
Constant public entry price of 0.1 ETH per player per stage.
Private constant-derived amount of ETH intended for P3D buy per stage (deprecated path).
View getter returning the loser of the last finalized stage.
View getter returning slot 0 of the last finalized stage.
View getter returning slot 2 of the last finalized stage.
View getter returning slot 0 of the current stage.
View getter returning slot 1 of the current stage.

View getter returning the current jackpot size.
View helper indicating whether the pending stage is ready to be finalized.
View getter returning the next refund recipient in the waiting line.
View getter of the contract P3D token balance via external call.
Public function that spends the pending masternode ETH to buy P3D, defaulting to a hardcoded address.
Fetches P3D dividends, pays SPASM and routes the remainder to Refundpot and Jackpot.
Payable function adding msg.value to Refundpot.
Pays 0.1 ETH from Refundpot to the next address in the refund line and advances the cursor.
Payable function that sets a vanity string and forwards funds to buy P3D for a masternode.
Deploys the initial Stage and sets numberOfStages to 1.
Empty payable fallback that accepts plain ETH transfers.
Payable entry point paying OFFER_SIZE to join the current stage and attempt finalization.
Entry point debiting OFFER_SIZE from playerVault to join the current stage and attempt finalization.
Finalizes pending stages, zeroes the caller vault and transfers the balance to msg.sender.
View getter of msg.sender vault balance.
View getter of the player count of the active stage.
Private routine that records the caller into the current stage slots and emits SacrificeOffered.
Public finalization routine that picks a loser via blockhash, pays winnings, jackpot and queue seeding.
Private routine crediting winningsPerRound to every non-sacrificed player of a stage.
Private routine refunding OFFER_SIZE to all players of a stage whose blockhash window expired.
Caller-controlled address used as player identity, vault owner and ETH transfer recipient.
External ETH transfer msg.sender.transfer(amount) executed inside withdraw().
External ETH transfer RefundWaitingLine[NextInLine].transfer(0.1 ether) to an arbitrary queued address.
External ETH transfer sacrifice.transfer(Jackpot) executed before Jackpot is zeroed.
External payable call p3dContract.buy.value(amt)(masternode) with a caller-supplied recipient.
External payable call p3dContract.buy.value(amt)(masternode) inside changevanity().
External call p3dContract.withdraw() that claims contract dividends.
External payable call SPASM_.disburse.value(base)() forwarding the SPASM share.
blockhash(stage.blocknumber) used as weak on-chain randomness for loser and jackpot selection.
Caller-supplied masternode address used as the P3D buy recipient in Expand.
Caller-supplied vanity string stored in Vanity[msg.sender].
Caller-supplied masternode address used as the P3D buy recipient.
Masternode address recorded in the stage and later funded for P3D purchase.
Masternode address recorded when paying from the vault.
Cached vault balance that is zeroed and then transferred to msg.sender.
Slot index derived from blockhash modulo MAX_PLAYERS_PER_STAGE.
blockhash modulo 1000 roll compared against 777 to award the jackpot.
Address selected as the loser; recipient of the jackpot transfer and queue entry.
Address excluded from survivor winnings distribution.
Index of the stage being invalidated and refunded.
Local copy of Refundpot used to guard the 0.1 ETH payout.
msg.sender cached as the player written into the stage slot and player set.

normalization_plan.reason: The masternode parameter is only the recipient argument of the external p3dContract.buy call in Expand.
The van parameter is immediately written into Vanity[msg.sender] inside changevanity.
The masternode parameter is used as the recipient of the external p3dContract.buy call in changevanity.
MN is only stored in the stage via acceptOffer and used for later masternode funding.
MN is only stored in the stage when paying the entry from the vault.
The amount local is a temporary cache of the vault balance paid out by withdraw.
sacrificeSlot is a transient index derived from blockhash inside tryFinalizeStage.
The jackpot roll is a transient comparison value local to tryFinalizeStage.
The sacrifice local is the recipient of the external jackpot transfer.
The sacrifice parameter only controls the exclusion check in the winnings loop.
stageIndex only selects the Stage struct being refunded by invalidateStage.
Pot is a transient snapshot of Refundpot used for the payout guard in Payoutnextrefund.
The player local is just the cached msg.sender written into the stage slots.
